description: Prepare 1–50 unsigned EIP-712 orders in one request; this creates signing payloads only and accepts nothing into matching.

WeiString.description: Non-negative integer amount in the token's smallest unit (wei for ETH-family tokens; the play-money token PM uses 6). Always read the decimals from the token or market metadata rather than assuming them. Serialized as a base-10 string to avoid JS number precision loss.

amount.description: Order size in OUTCOME-TOKEN smallest units, using the market collateral's decimals (PM: 6 — always read decimals from market metadata). One whole outcome token redeems for one whole collateral token; this field is NOT a collateral amount. Collateral locked = price × amount ÷ 10000.

chainId.description: Chain id for the market address. Required when the same market address exists on multiple chains.

clOrdId.description: Client-supplied order id (maximum 200 characters; optional at placement; off-chain and not part of the EIP-712 Order / orderHash). Used for reconciliation, cancel-by-clOrdId, and live-order idempotency: the same (wallet, clOrdId) with matching (market, side, price, amount, kind) returns the existing open/partially-filled order; a divergent body yields 409 CLORDID_CONFLICT. After the order reaches a terminal status the id may be reused. Orthogonal to the HTTP Idempotency-Key header (transport-level).

nonce.description: Order nonce for a user-signed EIP-712 order

orderSignature.description: User EIP-712 signature over the order. Omit to receive signing payload.

postOnly.description: Maker-only (off-chain, not signed): reject the order if any part would cross the book on placement, so it can never pay taker.

price.description: Limit price in basis points. Must land on this market's price grid, published as tradingRules.priceBands: default markets are BANDED — 10-bps rungs below 500 and above 9500, 100-bps rungs in between — and an off-grid price is refused with 400 PRICE_OFF_TICK naming the two nearest legal prices. Resting orders (GTC or postOnly) meet tradingRules.minRestingShares and minRestingExpirySeconds. Passive postOnly orders have no collateral-notional minimum (minRestingNotional is 0). Active BUY orders (postOnly absent or false) retain the book snapshot's effectiveMinBuyAmount: principal notional for GTC, total budget including fees for IOC/FOK. IOC/FOK SELL meets minSellShares. A verified entire-position SELL is exempt from size floors. There is no longer a per-fill collateral floor: settlement stopped asserting the market's minBuyAmount in the 2026-08-31 beacon upgrade, so that field is a deprecated, unenforced record and no size need be checked against it. Provide either price or priceDecimal.

priceDecimal.description: Limit price as a 0–1 decimal probability (agent convention): 0.55 = 5500 bps. Converted by rounding to the nearest whole BPS; the result must then land on this market's price grid (tradingRules.priceBands) or placement returns PRICE_OFF_TICK with the two nearest legal prices — a stated limit price is never silently moved. Provide either price (bps) or priceDecimal — not both.

timeInForce.description: Time-in-force (off-chain, not signed): GTC rests until filled/cancelled (default); IOC fills what crosses now and cancels the remainder; FOK fills the full amount or is rejected.

proofNonce.description: Required single-use nonce for the wallet proof. Fetch from POST /api/auth/nonce; consumed on verification so the proof cannot be replayed.

signatureTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) used in the signed challenge message

walletAddress.description: Checksummed or lowercase 20-byte EVM address (0x + 40 hex).

walletSignature.description: Action-bound wallet proof. Sign the canonical 'problee-mcp-auth:…' challenge (binds agent, apiKey, tool, scope, chain, resource, payloadHash, nonce, timestamp).
